title: Contact in Under 1 Minute: Connect Your Ads, CRM, and WhatsApp
body:
You are paying top dollar for every lead on Facebook Ads or Google, but... how long does it take you to contact them?

The statistics in B2B and B2C sales are overwhelming: if you take more than 5 minutes to contact a lead who just left their details, your chances of closing the sale drop by 80%. The problem is that in most companies, leads pile up in an Excel sheet downloaded manually twice a day, or in a saturated inbox. By the time your sales rep calls, the client is already talking to your competition.

The Nightmare of Manual Transfers

Copying and pasting data from Meta forms or your website into your CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive) is low-value work that frustrates sales teams. Furthermore, using limited bridging tools means that when traffic spikes, data gets lost or arrives late.

Our Solution: The Real-Time Data Highway

At LANZAESTUDIO.ES we design and deploy custom Webhooks and API connections so the lead's journey is instant and invisible. From the moment the user clicks submit until they receive the first message, less than 3 seconds pass.

  1. Instant Capture: In the exact millisecond a user submits a form on your website, Facebook, or TikTok, our system captures the data payload.
  2. Direct CRM Injection: We automatically insert the contact into your CRM, assigning the campaign tag and notifying the sales rep on duty.
  3. WhatsApp Impact: We use the official WhatsApp Business API to send an automatic, hyper-personalized message, greeting them by name and delivering the info they requested.
  4. Pre-Qualification: If desired, we can connect a bot to ask 3 key qualifying questions via WhatsApp before your sales rep invests time calling them.

The Impact on Your Closing Rates

  • The 'Wow' Effect: The client receives a message on their phone while they are still holding it. The perception of professionalism multiplies.
  • Zero Lost Leads: A cloud system never forgets to log a contact or misplaces emails.
  • Massive Conversion Increase: By being the first to respond, your sales teams meet a receptive client, multiplying the ROI of your advertising spend.
